title: Al-Jabbar: The Quran Uses This Word Ten Times. Nine of Them Are an Accusation.
excerpt: Al-Jabbar occurs ten times in the Quran. Nine describe human beings and every one of the nine is hostile — two of them are prophets being cleared of it. The tenth is the divine name.
seo_title: Al-Jabbar: Meaning of the Divine Name in the Quran
seo_description: Al-Jabbar appears 10 times in the Quran; 9 describe tyrants and 1 names Allah. What al-Jalalayn says the divine name means, and why the human uses are all accusations.
